commits.author: Giulio Ardoino
commits.subject: fix: keep the Android back button inside the app
commits.body:
Back from any view other than the session list closed the app instead of
navigating, and it dismissed nothing when a sheet or dialog was open.

Adapted from @birabittoh's #30, with three changes: exitApp no longer runs
inside a setView updater, which React may invoke more than once; a listener
that finishes registering after teardown is now removed rather than leaked;
and back closes the delete dialog, an inline rename, or an open detail sheet
before it changes view.

Co-authored-by: Marco Andronaco <andronacomarco@gmail.com>

commits.author: Giulio Ardoino
commits.subject: feat: queue a follow-up prompt instead of blocking the composer
commits.body:
The composer was disabled while the agent worked, so a follow-up meant waiting
or stopping the run. Adapted from @birabittoh's #31, which on its own would have
failed against OMP: the bridge rejected a second prompt with "The OMP session is
already running", surfacing an error where the user expected a queued message.

The bridge now queues it. The prompt is recorded immediately, so it is visible
while it waits, the session keeps reporting busy between turns, its model is
applied on dequeue rather than under the running turn, and stopping the session
discards both the queue and the messages recorded for it.

Verified against OMP 17.1.3: a prompt sent mid-turn is accepted and answered
after the current turn ends.

Co-authored-by: Marco Andronaco <andronacomarco@gmail.com>

+### PI Bridge Setup
+
+Harness Remote connects to PI through the same ACP bridge, using the community
+[`pi-acp`](https://github.com/victor-software-house/pi-acp) adapter. The bridge
+starts the adapter over stdio and translates ACP into the HTTP/SSE API used by
+the app.
+
+#### Prerequisites
+
+- Node.js 24 or newer, as required by the current PI ACP adapter;
+- PI provider credentials configured for the adapter;
+- a checkout of this repository on the computer that runs the bridge.
+
+Start the bridge from the repository root:
+
+```bash
+npx --yes ./bridge \
+  --backend pi \
+  --host 0.0.0.0 \
+  --port 4097 \
+  --username pi \
+  --password "use-a-long-unique-password" \
+  --root "$HOME/Software"
+```
+
+The `pi` backend defaults to `npx -y @victor-software-house/pi-acp`. Use
+`--acp-command` and repeated `--acp-arg` options if the adapter is installed
+globally or launched from a local checkout.
+
+In the app, select **PI (ACP bridge)** and enter the same host, port, username,
+and password. A successful health check reports `backend: "pi"` and the
+adapter version.
+
+PI supports session listing, history replay, streaming prompts, cancellation,
+queued follow-up prompts, and model selection. Plan/todo updates, persistent
+session rename/delete, server slash commands, and VCS/diff are not currently
+exposed through this bridge.
+
+The bridge's `--root` restriction applies to directory browsing and new-session
+selection; it is not a sandbox for PI. The adapter still runs with the full
+filesystem privileges of the account that launched it. Do not expose the
+bridge directly to the Internet; use a trusted LAN, VPN, or TLS-terminating
+reverse proxy.
+

commits.subject: Merge upstream/main (v2.0.0 Harness Remote rebrand + Oh My Pi backend)
commits.body:
Resolves the 10-hunk App.tsx conflict per the owner's PR review (#32):
- keep upstream's multi-backend config layer, loadedMessagesRef snapshot
  logic, and the autosave host-validation guard that prevents a
  half-typed host from bricking the app
- keep this branch's isNearMessagesBottom scroll tracking, MessagesPane
  extraction, and session-card layout, merged with upstream's OMP gating
  and Open button
- gate the questions fetch in loadSelected behind config.backend, since
  the OMP bridge doesn't implement that endpoint
- update ui-regression.test.mjs's auto-scroll assertion to verify the
  stickToBottomRef gate instead of forbidding messageScrollSignature
  outright, preserving pinned-scroll-while-streaming behavior

All test:i18n/test:config/test:ui/test:settings/test:model/test:events
and the bridge test suite pass; npm run build succeeds.
